notes.title: Upcoming Features for Dead Unending 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update for Dead Unending Coming May 2025![/h1]

I'm excited to announce a [b]major update[/b] for [i]Dead Unending[/i] arriving in [b]May 2025[/b]! 

I’ll be posting updates throughout the development process as more content is added, and I’ll continue fixing bugs found during [u][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeQ0i02rgb2MqUqD_CYVm7IaElItdZApsjdBnsOOjZUKduNyg/viewform?usp=sf_link]continuous playtesting[/url][u]

Stay tuned for more details, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Dead Unending Path Notes 1.1
notes.content:
I've taken your feedback into account and made some important updates to improve your gameplay experience. Here's what's new in this version:

[b]Breakable Fences[/b]: Fences are now breakable by zombies. Wooden fences can support 2 zombies before breaking, and stronger fences provide better support.

[b]Improved Minimap[/b]: The minimap has been upgraded with a higher quality map render

[b]Camera Snap Enabled by Default[/b]: Based on your feedback, camera snap is now enabled by default, camera will gravitate towards the nearest 45 degree mark. 

[b]Updated Prices & Quests[/b]: I've adjusted prices and quests to improve pacing and extend the overall gameplay length, in response to your feedback and initial testing.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]: I've fixed minor bugs to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable experience.

Please note that with this update, player builds will be shuffled around. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Upcoming Features Throughout 2023:

Building Anywhere: Soon, you'll be able to build structures anywhere on the map, More Content: including items, objectives, late game builds, and gameplay mechanics, Co-op Multiplayer: Cooperative multiplayer is coming first, followed by a PvE mode later in the year, Console Support.
